notes.title: Once A Tale will take a bit longer...
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

We have been telling you for months that the release of Once A Tale would be in March. We are now approaching the date we thought Once A Tale would be ready. However, some things came up at the last moment.

The recent feedback from the demo proves to us what we already felt from the beginning: that Once a Tale is something special. But even though we tried as hard as possible to keep the deadlines we had given ourselves, we realize that in order to create the best game possible, we are going to need some extra time. This will give us time to further polish the game and pursue discussions with partners. 
We owe it to ourselves and to you to get this right. We really hope you understand.

That being said, we are still really excited and eager to release Once A Tale and hope you will be too.
We promise we won’t make you wait too long!

In the meantime, we do have a few things we have been working on:
•    YouTube videos for Once a Tale’s soundtracks
•    Devlogs 3 and 4

We’ll continue to keep you updated with all the latest info about development, and if there is anything you would like us to make or show you: Let us know!

Thank you to all of you for your patience and support.

The Once a Tale team

notes.title: February News Update: Articles, Events & Feedback
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43580075/613227a4f4bd94137c1fc9f2f778081b88d379c4.png
Hello Everyone!

Here is the last countdown post we will make before Once A Tale's release! Do not worry, we will still keep you updated on the latest news about our game. This only means we are very close to everyone experiencing the full Once A Tale! 

We wanted to mention how appreciative we are of those who gave us feedback on the game after playing the demo. It has been a big help in fixing things up and setting the game up for success upon release. But first, we have some news related to the events that Once A Tale was a part of these past weeks, and news about the Devlogs, so lets get right into it!

Events
As you may know, we have been featured in Games from Québec and in Steam Next Fest the last couple of weeks. We are excited to say that has helped us tremendously to get closer to our goals before launch!

So welcome to all the new players, thank you for downloading Once A Tale's Demo, and most of all, thank you for adding Once A Tale to your wishlists!

If you are new and you want to join a growing community, or chat with the devs here is a link to our discord.

Article about Once A Tale!
Thank you to GamesRadar for the kind words in your recent article about Once A Tale.

"...Once a Tale sees players take control of two children as they explore unfamiliar surroundings, work together to solve puzzles, and uncover the truth of how they got there in the first place. Unlike Little Nightmares, this adventure game is a bit more family-friendly and takes inspiration from the Brothers Grimm story of Hansel and Gretel, as well as other well-known tales. "

For more, Click here

Devlogs
We have been brewing up some more devlogs for you to get an insider look into what it takes to make a stop-motion style game like Once A Tale. Click here to watch Devlog #02!

Feedback
With your feedback, we were able to fix some problems in the full game. After a bit of testing, we should be able to update the demo version as well.

 Mouse and Keyboard controls now work better when the camera changes
 You can now turn off Vsync to help performance
 ...more!



Thank you to everyone for your support, we hope to see you soon with more good news!
The Dev Team

notes.title: Upcoming events featuring Once A Tale
notes.content:
Hello all!

Once A Tale has been getting some time on the front page, and we are happy to say that is not over!

here are some events that Once A Tale is a part of:

For all of the new gamers following Once A Tale since this event, we wanted to let you know that if you liked the Demo, wishlisting Once A Tale on Steam could be a tremendous help to us while also keeping you updated with the latest news about the game:

Steam Next Fest
We will be a part of the Steam Next Fest event this upcoming week! from February 5th to 12th we will showcase a stream on our page to show you some gameplay and answer a few questions we prepared.

If you have questions you would like answered about Once A Tale, you can tune into our Livestream on Twitch or on our Steam page on Friday the 9th at 1pm EST! Twitch link / Steam Page

notes.title: January News Update (2 months left!)
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43580075/00c283d3225d3e20ccba8ef4f9700fcb000a9802.png

Happy New Year everyone!

There is only a little over 2 months left until Once A Tale releases and our anticipation builds with every post we make in the countdown.

Public Demo
As you may have heard last week, Once A Tale has an official demo that is publicly available to play on Steam! So if you want to get a taste of the enchanting world that we handcrafted, please download the demo and let us know what you think!

Streams and Giveaways
We told you in our last Steam update that we would be announcing a giveaway, so here is the plan:
We are going to host a few streams until the game is released and during those streams, there will be an opportunity to win a copy of Once A Tale. We can't tell you which one or how many, but there will be at least one!

The next stream will be this Friday, on January 19th from 1pm to 3pm EST time. You can also follow our Twitch Page to be sure not to miss it https://www.twitch.tv/carcajougames !

As always, if you would like to participate in growing the Once A Tale community, please join us on Discord!

notes.title: December 2023 Update
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43580075/18d3fcf5f78108b6b1c96063152f67d3a34232b4.png

 Three Months Until Release! 

The holidays are upon us and we hope you are enjoying a warm beverage as you read this update (if not, we understand. You maybe shouldn't bring food near a computer...).

For those of you who have not read the last update, we have a release month and it is March 2024. In preparation for this big event, we have a few things planned!

Once A Tale Streams

You may have seen that streamers have started playing Once A Tale. Head to Twitch to catch one of them showing some fun gameplay (without big story spoilers). Let us know what you think of the game on our socials or even on Discord!

Reddit - Facebook - Instagram - TikTok

Upcoming Once A Tale Streams:

3QCrew - Tisir (Fr) : December 17th
Cobmob (De) : December 17th
Guiguicoul (Fr) : December 18th
 ... and more!


A warm thanks to streamers who have already streamed Once A Tale this month: Hastiles (Fr), Twilitzal (En), UrgentPigeon (Fr).

If you are a streamer yourself, and you would like to be able to stream Once A Tale:  Join our Discord for more information on how to stream Once A Tale.

Giveaways

The Holidays are the season of giving and we want to give back to our supportive community by hosting a giveaway for a copy of Once A Tale!

Keep an eye on our socials for more information coming soon!

Thank you for being a part of our story and we hope you have very Happy Holidays!
The Team

notes.title: November 2023 Update
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43580075/8d89b93e9a2c7dc7a2d3602fe2ac4b6bd65b33ab.png

The Countdown has started!
Once A Tale's release is planned for: March 2024

Once A Tale is now less than 4 months away from release and we could not be more thrilled! This means you will see more updates like these roll around as we approach the launch.

What you can expect from us until then:

 Content for Once A Tale on Twitch and YouTube: Watch your favorite streamers test our game!
 Livestreams: We will host livestreams! Q&As and new content, yes please!
 Playtests: There may be more opportunities to playtest Once A Tale before the release.
 Devlogs: We are going to be making Devlogs about Once A Tale's development. If you interested keep reading!


Devlog #01 - Photogrammetry

You've asked us what it's like to create a handcrafted game. So here is a video all about the process of creating our handmade characters and props that would become the assets in our game.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=q50JONbY5o4&t=101

Growing our Community

Discord
Every game strives to have a great welcoming community, and Once A Tale is no different. We recently announced that we had a Discord server that has since had it's first exclusive playtest session. We intend to continue involving our Discord community as much as we can until the release, as well as long after. If you're interested in joining the Once A Tale Discord, if you want a chance to be a part of the story!

Join the Once A Tale Discord

Reddit
In our strides toward getting Once A Tale more visibility, we created a reddit community. So if you are a fan of Reddit and would like to receive your Once A Tale news on the platform, we would love for you to join our fresh new community!

You can expect to find some content on reddit that we won't share elsewhere:

 Exclusive Q&As
 Recap of what's been happening
 Art contests and Giveaways
 Discussions about the development and content of Once A Tale


If that sounds like your cup of tea here is a link to our Reddit community


We are excited for all of the great things to come. Thank you for your time and for sticking with us!

The Dev Team
